title: Hohenschwangau Klassik: Bergkonzert Königliche Trompetenklänge
location: Ort der Besinnung, Bergstation Tegelbergbahn, Schwangau
description: Mountain-top concert of the Hohenschwangau Klassik festival with trumpeters Georg Hiemer, Martin Ehlich and Daniel Noske, a brass trumpet trio in the high Alps. Moves to the Panoramarestaurant in case of rain. Entry is free on the Pay as you want principle; the Tegelbergbahn runs special early rides from 8:30 at regular fares. Info at hohenschwangau-klassik.com.

title: 24. Tegelberglauf und Tegelberg Nachwuchslauf
description: The 24. Tegelberglauf of TSV Schwangau is an 8 km mountain run with about 920 m of climbing up the Tegelberg, held today, Sunday 2 August, from 10:00. The Tegelberg Nachwuchslauf for kids and youth aged 6 to 15 runs alongside the main race. Online registration is closed but Nachmeldungen are possible on site; info at www2.tsv-schwangau.de/tegelberglauf.

title: KÖRPERWELTEN & Der Zyklus des Lebens (Ausstellung bis 11.10.2026)
description: The famous anatomy exhibition by Dr. Gunther von Hagens runs at the bigBOX ALLGÄU in Kempten until 11 October 2026. Real plastinated bodies show how the human body works, which curious kids often find fascinating. Open Mon to Fri 9:00 to 18:00 and Sat, Sun and holidays 10:00 to 18:00, last admission 17:00. Time window tickets at koerperwelten.de or Eventim.

title: Mittelaltermarkt Füssen (letzter Markttag)
description: Final day of the three day Mittelaltermarkt that turns the Von-Freyberg-Park near the station into a medieval village with craft stalls, music stages and performers. Sunday opening hours are 10:00 to 18:00 and admission is free. Info at mittelaltermarkt-fuessen.de.

title: Hohenschwangau Klassik: Familienkonzert Opernhits für Kids
description: Family concert of the Hohenschwangau Klassik festival with opera hits like Papageno and Carmen, performed with voice, cello and light-hearted moderation for children from age 5. The concert lasts about 45 minutes. Entry is free on the Pay as you want principle, no reservation needed. Info at hohenschwangau-klassik.com.

title: Chill & Dine mit Live-Musik
description: Open-air evening with live music and a view of the royal castles at Hotel Rübezahl between Schwangau and Hohenschwangau. Food and drinks from the hotel kitchen; info via Hotel Rübezahl or the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: Oberstdorfer Musiksommer: Die Singphoniker
description: The vocal ensemble Die Singphoniker celebrates its 40 year history with works by Schubert, Strauss and Bach alongside pop arrangements. Part of the Oberstdorfer Musiksommer 2026 (30 July to 14 August). Tickets via oberstdorfer-musiksommer.de or Eventim.

title: Neuschwanstein Konzerte: Für immer! Gebaute Träume, gelebte Musik
description: Closing night of the Neuschwanstein Konzerte 2026 open-air festival in the upper castle courtyard, the successor of the famous Sängersaal Schlosskonzerte. Tenor Piotr Beczala, soprano Olga Peretyatko and mezzo-soprano Nadezhda Karyazina sing opera by Offenbach, Gounod and Verdi with the Münchner Symphoniker under Andreas Klippert. Admission from 19:30, ticket includes parking in Hohenschwangau and shuttle to the castle. Tickets at neuschwansteinkonzerte.eu or Eventim, hotline +49 831 2065555.

title: Hohenschwangau Klassik: Abschlusskonzert Best of Baroque II
description: Festive closing concert of the Hohenschwangau Klassik 2026 festival in the baroque pilgrimage church St. Coloman. Baroque works with oboe sisters Hannah and Sophia Streif, flutist Elya Levin and the string players of the Solistenensemble D'Accord. Entry is free on the Pay as you want principle. Info at hohenschwangau-klassik.com.

title: The Odyssey (OV)
description: The Odyssey, the 2026 big-screen epic adaptation of Homer's classic (running time about 2h 53min), screens in the English original version (engl. Originalversion) in Saal 2. Tickets are available online via the Alpenfilmtheater website (cineorder.alpenfilmtheater.de) or at the cinema box office.

title: Königswinkel Open Air: Mark Forster
description: Mark Forster plays the Königswinkel Open Airs 2026 in the Barockgarten am Festspielhaus Füssen, on a stage built partly over the Forggensee with views of Neuschwanstein and Hohenschwangau. Doors open 18:00, support act YOLA & DANI at 19:30, main show 20:30. Tickets via ac-live.de and Eventim.

title: Cinderella - Das Musical
description: Family musical at the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein on the shore of the Forggensee. This is the first August performance in the calendar window; the show runs regularly through 13 September 2026, typically Saturdays 14:30 and Sundays 11:00 plus selected weekdays. Tickets via das-festspielhaus.de or hotline 08362 5077 777.

title: Oberstdorfer Musiksommer: Ingolf Turban & Tomoko Sawallisch
description: Violin and piano duo recital with violinist Ingolf Turban and pianist Tomoko Sawallisch, billed as virtuos, vielseitig, brillant, ein Duo der Spitzenklasse. Part of the Oberstdorfer Musiksommer 2026. Tickets via oberstdorfer-musiksommer.de or Eventim.

title: LUDWIG² Das Musical
description: The signature musical about King Ludwig II in the theatre built for it, with Neuschwanstein visible across the lake. This entry marks the first August performance in the window; LUDWIG² runs regularly through 13 September 2026, typically Saturdays 19:00 and Sundays 15:30 plus weekday shows. Tickets via das-festspielhaus.de or hotline 08362 5077 777.

title: Abendfahrt mit Live-Musik "AlpenGrageeler"
description: Evening cruise on the Forggensee aboard the MS Füssen with live Volksmusik and Schlager by the duo AlpenGrageeler (Andi and Gerd). Boarding from 19:00, departure 19:30, duration about 2 hours. Adults 28 EUR, children 14 EUR; tickets online via the Forggensee-Schifffahrt shop or at the evening box office on board.

title: Oberstdorfer Musiksommer: Atos Trio
description: Piano trio evening with the Atos Trio, described by the Washington Post as one of the elite piano trios playing before the public today. A strong pick for chamber music and cello lovers at the Oberstdorfer Musiksommer 2026. Tickets via oberstdorfer-musiksommer.de or Eventim.

title: Musikkapelle Prem am Schlossbrauhaus
description: Traditional Bavarian brass music evening with the Musikkapelle Prem at the Schlossbrauhaus brewery, outdoors in the beer garden if the weather allows. Free admission, food and house-brewed beer available. Info at schlossbrauhaus.de or +49 8362 9264680.

title: Königswinkel Open Air: MONTEZ - 15 Jahre Jubiläums-Tour
description: MONTEZ celebrates 15 years on stage with his Jubiläums-Tour 2026 at the Königswinkel Open Airs in the Barockgarten am Festspielhaus Füssen. Doors open 18:15, opening act Nio at 19:00, main show at 20:00. Tickets via Eventim or the Festspielhaus ticket hotline 08362 5077 777.

title: Kaisersaalkonzert: Laura Lootens & Dominik Wagner
location: Kaisersaal im Barockkloster St. Mang, Füssen
description: Guitar and double bass duo recital with guitarist Laura Lootens and double bassist Dominik Wagner in the anniversary season 75 Jahre Kaisersaalkonzerte Füssen (1951 to 2026). Part of the summer series in the baroque Kaisersaal of Kloster St. Mang. Tickets via Tourist Information Füssen or Allgäuticket, phone 0831 206-5555.

title: Sisi & Ludwigs Musicalschiff (Premiere)
description: Sunset musical cruise aboard the MS Füssen with musical stars Janet Chvatal and Marc Gremm plus Tanja Versal as Sisi and König Ludwig II, with guest star Jan Ammann on the premiere weekend 7 to 9 August. The show then runs Friday to Sunday evenings through 30 August 2026, boarding 19:15, departure 19:45, about 2 hours, only about 110 guests per sailing. Tickets from 61.90 EUR (premiere dates from 81.90 EUR), sold exclusively online at musicalschiff.de.

title: Königswinkel Open Air: Sarah Connor - Wilde Nächte Open Air 2026
description: Sarah Connor brings her Wilde Nächte Open Air 2026 tour with songs from the number 1 album FREIGEISTIN plus her hits to the Barockgarten am Festspielhaus Füssen. General admission from 18:00, DJane DayBeeDee at 19:30, main show 20:30. Tickets via Eventim or the Festspielhaus ticket hotline 08362 5077 777.

title: Grillfest der Feuerwehr Weissensee
description: Public barbecue party of the Freiwillige Feuerwehr Weissensee at the Feuerwehrhaus, the main summer fire brigade event in the village this season. Listed as public in the official Weissensee Vereinstermine 2026. No tickets needed, just turn up.

title: Live-Musik-Abend in der Ludwig Bar
location: Ludwig Bar, AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort, Hohenschwangau
description: Weekly Saturday live music evening in the Ludwig Bar of the AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort in Hohenschwangau, with changing artists each week. Free entry with bar service; info via the hotel or the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: 19. Allgäu Panorama Marathon
description: Big mountain running weekend in Sonthofen, about 45 minutes from Füssen, with ultra (69 km), marathon, half marathon and 18 km Hörnerlauf on Sunday 9 August, plus a 5 km run and Kids-Run on Saturday 8 August. Start times vary by distance and were not yet listed, so verify the Zeitplan on the organizer site. Online registration until 6 August at allgaeu-panorama-marathon.de.

title: Partielle Sonnenfinsternis - Lange Nacht der Astronomie
description: Special free evening at the Allgäuer Volkssternwarte Ottobeuren to watch the partial solar eclipse through the observatory telescopes with expert guidance. A rare chance for the boys to see an eclipse safely. Free admission, info at avso.de or phone 08332 9366058.

title: Abendfahrt mit den Alphornbläsern "Alpen-Hörner"
description: Atmospheric evening cruise with the alphorn players Alpen-Hörner, who play from the shore as the ship departs, while the captain gives commentary on the Forggensee and the mountain panorama. Boarding from 19:00, departure 19:30, about 2 hours. Adults 26 EUR, children 13 EUR; tickets online via the Forggensee-Schifffahrt shop or on board.

title: Oberstdorfer Musiksommer: Elias Ackerley
description: Classical music recital by Elias Ackerley, winner at the ARD International Music Competition 2025, in a concert recorded by BR-Klassik. Part of the Oberstdorfer Musiksommer 2026. Tickets via oberstdorfer-musiksommer.de or Eventim.

title: Perseiden-Nacht an der Sternwarte
description: The Lange Nacht der Astronomie continues after the solar eclipse with observation of the Perseid meteor shower at its peak night. Bring warm clothes and blankets for shooting star watching. Free admission, details at avso.de.

title: Kaisersaalkonzert: Spark - die klassische Band
location: Kaisersaal im Barockkloster St. Mang, Füssen
description: The award-winning quintet Spark, known as die klassische Band, mixes recorders, violin, cello and piano in their programme closing the 2026 Kaisersaalkonzerte anniversary season in the Kaisersaal of Barockkloster St. Mang. Tickets via Tourist Information Füssen or Allgäuticket, phone 0831 206-5555.

title: 2 Legenden 1 Konzert - A Tribute to ABBA & Udo Jürgens
description: Tribute concert evening honouring ABBA and Udo Jürgens at the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein. Tickets from about 55 euros via das-festspielhaus.de or the ticket hotline 08362 5077 777.

title: Oberstdorfer Musiksommer: Trombone Unit Hannover (Abschlusskonzert)
description: Closing concert of the Oberstdorfer Musiksommer 2026 with the Trombone Unit Hannover trombone ensemble. Several of the festival's mountain station concerts are already sold out, so early booking is advisable. Tickets via oberstdorfer-musiksommer.de or Eventim.

title: Maria Himmelfahrt mit Kirchenkaffee
description: Feast day service for Maria Himmelfahrt at the parish church St. Walburga, followed by Kirchenkaffee in the Ruhegarten. A public village event listed in the official Weissensee Vereinstermine 2026. Everyone is welcome.

title: Markt für Handwerkskunst
description: Craft market at the Schlossbrauhaus with around 40 selected artisans showing ceramics, wood, jewellery and more. Admission is free. Exact opening hours were not published, time tbc, verify at schlossbrauhaus.de or Tourist Information Schwangau.

title: Alphornspielen am Forggensee
description: Alphorn players perform at the boat landing in Schwangau-Waltenhofen on the Forggensee, alpine horn music by the lake a few minutes from Hohenschwangau. Free open-air event. Info via Tourist Information Schwangau, schwangau.de.

title: Live-Musik-Abend in der Ludwig Bar
location: Ludwig Bar, AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort, Hohenschwangau
description: Weekly Saturday live music evening in the Ludwig Bar of the AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort in Hohenschwangau, with changing artists each week. Info via the hotel or the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: Filmvorführung Der Forggensee
description: Free open screening of the documentary film Der Forggensee at the Schlossbrauhaus, starting 20:15. A repeat screening is scheduled for 13 September 2026 at the same time. Info at schlossbrauhaus.de.

title: Feuerwehr zum Anfassen
location: Feuerwehrhaus und Kiosk am Freibad, Füssen-Weissensee
description: Hands-on fire brigade evening in Weissensee, with the Feuerwehr museum open at the Feuerwehrhaus from 18:00 and a live demonstration at the Kiosk am Freibad at 18:45. Family friendly and free. Listed in the official Weissensee Vereinstermine 2026.

title: Never Enough! - Das Musical
description: Musical production shown on selected dates at the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein: 18 and 19 August at 18:00, and again 9 and 10 September 2026. Tickets via das-festspielhaus.de or hotline 08362 5077 777.

title: König-Ludwig-Abendfahrt
description: Evening themed cruise with the Füssen historian Magnus Peresson, who brings the myth and building projects of König Ludwig II to life while the ship passes views of the royal castles. Boarding from 19:00, departure 19:30, about 2 hours. Adults 26 EUR, children 13 EUR; tickets online via the Forggensee-Schifffahrt shop or on board.

title: Women's European Cup of Nations: Germany vs France
description: Opening game of the Women's European Cup of Nations, the German women's national ice hockey team's first internationals of the season, played at the Bundesstützpunkt Arena in Füssen against France. Admission to all tournament games is free. Also broadcast live on MagentaSport. France, Norway and Hungary also play each other across the three days.

title: Wirtshausbühne: Das Glück kommt durch die Hintertür
description: Bavarian folk theatre by Uli Pickls Wirtshausbühne at the Schlossbrauhaus. Doors at 17:30 with dinner service until 19:30, performance at 20:00, admission 15 Euro, 8 Euro under 14. Further performances on 1 October, 22 October and 5 November 2026. Tickets at Tourist Information Schwangau.

title: Kunsthandwerkermarkt im Barockgarten
description: Three day open air craft market by Schröder Märkte in the Barockgarten at the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein. Hours are Friday 13:00 to 19:00, Saturday 11:00 to 19:00 and Sunday 10:00 to 17:00. Info at schroeder-maerkte.de.

title: Ritterabenteuer auf der Burgruine Sulzberg
description: Knight adventure afternoon for kids from age 5 with crossbow shooting, lance games, castle tower conquest, fairy tales and a campfire with sausages, ending with a knighting ceremony and certificate for each child. Meet at the Rathaus Sulzberg at 13:45, then a short walk to the castle ruin. Costs 4 Euro for adults and 3 Euro for children. Registration required at the Gästeinformation Sulzberg, phone 08376 9201-19.

title: Women's European Cup of Nations: Germany vs Norway
description: Second group game of the Women's European Cup of Nations in Füssen, Germany against Norway. Free admission to all tournament games at the Bundesstützpunkt Arena.

title: Blasmusikfest
description: Bavarian evening with the Musikkapelle Alpengruß, traditional Blasmusik (brass band) at the Bannwaldsee-Stadl by the Bannwaldsee in Schwangau. Info via the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: Unser Sonnensystem - Führung an der Sternwarte
description: Kid friendly public lecture and tour about the planets and their moons at the Allgäuer Volkssternwarte Ottobeuren, with telescope observation if the sky is clear. Costs 8 Euro per person, children up to 10 years 4 Euro. No booking needed, info at avso.de.

title: Women's European Cup of Nations: Germany vs Hungary
description: Final game of the Women's European Cup of Nations in Füssen, Germany against Hungary, an afternoon face-off that suits families. Free admission at the Bundesstützpunkt Arena.

title: Live-Musik-Abend in der Ludwig Bar
location: Ludwig Bar, AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort, Hohenschwangau
description: Weekly Saturday live music evening in the Ludwig Bar of the AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort in Hohenschwangau, with changing artists each week. Info via the hotel or the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: 44. Allgäu Triathlon
location: Bühl am Alpsee, Immenstadt im Allgäu
description: Germany's longest-running triathlon at the Großer Alpsee with Classic (1.9/92/20), Olymp and Sprint distances on Sunday 23 August, first start wave 07:45. The Triathlon Bundesliga races take place on Friday evening 21 August. Entry is by lottery via Datasport and long closed, but it is a great spectator event; info at allgaeu-triathlon.com.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day (OV)
description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day (145 min) screens tonight in the English original version, labelled 2D OV on the cinema site. This is the only English OV screening published for the coming two weeks; the program beyond 26 August is not out yet. Tickets at the box office or via alpenfilmtheater.de.

title: Abendfahrt mit den Alphornbläsern "Alpen-Hörner"
description: Second August date of the evening cruise with the alphorn players Alpen-Hörner and captain's commentary on the lake and mountain scenery. Boarding from 19:00, departure 19:30, about 2 hours. Adults 26 EUR, children 13 EUR; tickets online via the Forggensee-Schifffahrt shop or on board.

title: Musikkapelle Musau am Schlossbrauhaus
description: Brass music evening with the Musikkapelle Musau from neighbouring Tirol at the Schlossbrauhaus, outdoors if the weather allows. Free admission. Info at schlossbrauhaus.de.

title: Königsgala 2026
description: Annual gala concert at the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein featuring highlights from the house productions and guest stars. Tickets from about 65 euros via das-festspielhaus.de or the ticket hotline 08362 5077 777.

title: Zugspitz Arena Gravel Triathlon
description: Premiere of the first official gravel triathlon in the DACH region, about 20 minutes from Füssen, with swimming in the Heiterwanger See, gravel bike legs through the Tiroler Zugspitz Arena and a flat lakeside run. Sprint, short distance and relay are offered on Saturday 29 August. Start time is not yet published, verify and register via time2win.at.

title: Alphornspielen am Forggensee
description: Alphorn players perform at the boat landing in Schwangau-Waltenhofen on the Forggensee, alpine horn music by the lake a few minutes from Hohenschwangau. Free open-air event. Info via Tourist Information Schwangau, schwangau.de.

title: Live-Musik-Abend in der Ludwig Bar
location: Ludwig Bar, AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort, Hohenschwangau
description: Weekly Saturday live music evening in the Ludwig Bar of the AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort in Hohenschwangau, with changing artists each week. Info via the hotel or the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: Öffentliche Schlossführung Schloss Kronburg
description: Public guided tour of the castle courtyard and museum at Schloss Kronburg, a Renaissance castle in the Burgenregion Allgäu. The tour lasts about 1.5 hours and costs 10 Euro per person. Registration is desired but not required, phone 08394-271, details at schloss-kronburg.de.

title: Lichtbildervortrag: Das Märchenschloss Neuschwanstein und die umliegende Bergwelt
description: Illustrated lecture (in German) by Eugen Bader about Schloss Neuschwanstein and the surrounding mountain world at the Schlossbrauhaus. Info at schlossbrauhaus.de.

title: Festival vielsaitig: Eröffnungskonzert mit dem Leonkoro Quartet
location: Kaisersaal im Barockkloster St. Mang, Füssen
description: Opening concert of the 24th Festival vielsaitig, motto Spielräume, with the Leonkoro Quartet, violinists Maria Ioudenitch and Stephen Waarts, violist Timothy Ridout and cellist Julian Steckel. Works by Purcell, Mendelssohn Bartholdy and Enescu. Tickets from 12 May 2026 via Tourist Information Füssen or Allgäuticket and Eventim.

title: Festival vielsaitig: Florian Weber, Klavier
location: Kaisersaal im Barockkloster St. Mang, Füssen
description: Jazz night of the Festival vielsaitig: pianist Florian Weber combines classical virtuosity with contemporary jazz improvisation in the Kaisersaal. Tickets via Tourist Information Füssen or Allgäuticket.

title: Ritterabenteuer auf der Burgruine Sulzberg
description: Second late summer date of the knight adventure for kids from age 5 on the Burgruine Sulzberg, with crossbow shooting, lance games, storytelling, campfire and the knighting ceremony at the end. Meet at the Rathaus Sulzberg at 13:45. Costs 4 Euro for adults and 3 Euro for children, registration required at the Gästeinformation Sulzberg, phone 08376 9201-19.

title: Festival vielsaitig: Musikalische Teestunde
description: Relaxed tea hour concert with participants of the Leonkoro Quartet string quartet master class, part of the Festival vielsaitig 2026. Info and tickets via Tourist Information Füssen or Allgäuticket.

title: Festival vielsaitig: Kammerkonzert Brahms und Dvořák
location: Kaisersaal im Barockkloster St. Mang, Füssen
description: Chamber concert with Aris Alexander Blettenberg (Klavier), Maria Ioudenitch and Stephen Waarts (Violine), Timothy Ridout (Viola) and Julian Steckel (Violoncello). On the programme are the Brahms Trio in a minor op. 114 and Dvořák's Piano Quintet in A major op. 81. Tickets via Tourist Information Füssen or Allgäuticket.

title: Heimatabend am Schlossbrauhaus
description: Bavarian Heimatabend at the Schlossbrauhaus in Schwangau with the Gebirgstrachten- und Heimatverein D'Schwanstoaner Schwangau: traditional dancing, Schuhplattln and Bavarian brass band music. Table reservations recommended via the Schlossbrauhaus.

title: Absolute Musical - Die große Musicalgala
description: Gala evening with famous musical numbers at the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein. Tickets from about 53 euros via das-festspielhaus.de or the ticket hotline 08362 5077 777.

title: EV Füssen vs SC Riessersee (Testspiel)
description: Pre-season test game at home against derby rival SC Riessersee, a first look at the new EV Füssen squad two weeks before the Oberliga season opener. Face-off 19:30 per the club's pre-season announcement.

title: Unser Sonnensystem - Führung an der Sternwarte
description: Kid friendly lecture and tour about the planets and their moons at the Allgäuer Volkssternwarte Ottobeuren, with telescope observation if the sky is clear. Adults 8 Euro, children up to 10 years 4 Euro. Info at avso.de.

title: Festival vielsaitig: Abschlusskonzert des Meisterkurses
location: Kaisersaal im Barockkloster St. Mang, Füssen
description: Final concert of the string quartet master class led by the Leonkoro Quartet, with the young ensembles of the course performing in the Kaisersaal. Part of Festival vielsaitig 2026. Tickets via Tourist Information Füssen or Allgäuticket.

title: Rockabilly Abend mit den Red Back Spyders
description: Rockabilly party cruise on the Forggensee with a live set by the Red Back Spyders. Boarding from 18:30, departure 19:00, about 2.5 hours on the water. 42 EUR including a welcome drink; tickets online via the Forggensee-Schifffahrt shop or at the evening box office on board.

title: Live-Musik-Abend in der Ludwig Bar
location: Ludwig Bar, AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort, Hohenschwangau
description: Weekly Saturday live music evening in the Ludwig Bar of the AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort in Hohenschwangau, with changing artists each week. Info via the hotel or the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: 6. Standkonzert der Musikkapelle Weissensee
description: Final open air Standkonzert of the season by the Musikkapelle Weissensee at the Freibad on the lake shore, a Sunday morning Frühschoppen style concert. Free and public, listed in the official Weissensee Vereinstermine 2026.

title: Der Regenbogenfisch (Puppentheater Kaufbeuren)
description: Award-winning puppet show of the classic Regenbogenfisch story, 45 minutes, for children from age 3. This entry marks the first date; it plays Sundays at 16:00 through 25 October 2026. Children 7.50 EUR, adults 9.50 EUR. Info at puppentheater-kaufbeuren.de.

title: Chill & Dine mit Live-Musik
description: Open-air evening with live music and castle view at Hotel Rübezahl between Schwangau and Hohenschwangau. Info via Hotel Rübezahl or the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: Festival vielsaitig: Trio con Brio Copenhagen
location: Kaisersaal im Barockkloster St. Mang, Füssen
description: The renowned Trio con Brio Copenhagen with Soo-Jin Hong (Violine), Soo-Kyung Hong (Violoncello) and Jens Elvekjaer (Klavier) plays works by Boulanger, Shostakovich and Mendelssohn. Part of Festival vielsaitig 2026. Tickets via Tourist Information Füssen or Allgäuticket.

title: Festival vielsaitig: Bach Gambensonaten mit Romaniuk und Steckel
location: Kaisersaal im Barockkloster St. Mang, Füssen
description: Anthony Romaniuk (Tasteninstrumente) and cellist Julian Steckel perform Bach's viola da gamba sonatas BWV 1027 to 1029 in the Kaisersaal. A highlight for cello fans at Festival vielsaitig 2026. Tickets via Tourist Information Füssen or Allgäuticket.

title: Festival vielsaitig: Abschlusskonzert MGV Walhalla zum Seidlwirt
location: Kaisersaal im Barockkloster St. Mang, Füssen
description: The festival closes with the ensemble MGV Walhalla zum Seidlwirt, four first-class opera singers with a witty, self-ironic and nostalgic medley programme. Part of Festival vielsaitig 2026. Tickets via Tourist Information Füssen or Allgäuticket.

title: Kindermottofahrt "Starke Kinder auf hoher See"
description: Children's themed cruise "Unter dem Meer", an underwater adventure with games and activities run by the katholischer Kindergarten St. Gabriel. Boarding from 17:30, departure 18:00, about 2 hours. Adults 24 EUR, children 5 EUR; tickets online via the Forggensee-Schifffahrt shop or on board.

title: Ludwig2 Das Musical
description: Performance of the musical Ludwig2 about King Ludwig II of Bavaria with Jan Ammann in the title role, in the Festspielhaus on the Forggensee opposite Neuschwanstein. Begins at 19:30. Tickets via das-festspielhaus.de, performances of this production sell out regularly.

title: Alphornspielen am Forggensee
description: Alphorn players perform at the boat landing in Schwangau-Waltenhofen on the Forggensee, alpine horn music by the lake a few minutes from Hohenschwangau. Free open-air event. Info via Tourist Information Schwangau, schwangau.de.

title: Bierverkostung mit Schäffler Bräu
description: Beer tasting cruise with Schäffler Bräu and the StorfWirt, pairing six selected beers with a four course menu against the Forggensee panorama. Boarding from 18:30, departure 19:00, about 2.5 hours; admission from age 16. From 70 EUR; advance booking via the Forggensee-Schifffahrt online shop is required since menu events cannot be bought at the on-board box office.

title: Live-Musik-Abend in der Ludwig Bar
location: Ludwig Bar, AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort, Hohenschwangau
description: Weekly Saturday live music evening in the Ludwig Bar of the AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort in Hohenschwangau, with changing artists each week. Info via the hotel or the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: Filmvorführung Der Forggensee
description: Second screening of the documentary film about the Forggensee, its creation and the landscape around it, shown at the Schlossbrauhaus in Schwangau.

title: Das Ende der Sterne (The Dog Stars) in English OV
description: English original version screening of The Dog Stars, German title Das Ende der Sterne, a science fiction adventure thriller about a pilot who survives a devastating pandemic with his dog and defends a remote airfield alongside a former Marine. Runtime about 118 minutes. The only OV screening in the current Kinowoche; the following week's programme is normally published on Mondays.

title: Gastspiel Iberl Bühne: Hollerküacherl
description: Guest performance of the Munich Iberl Bühne with the play Hollerküacherl on Uli Pickls Wirtshausbühne at the Schlossbrauhaus. Doors at 17:30, performance at 20:00, admission 15 Euro. Tickets at Tourist Information Schwangau.

title: Heimatabend am Schlossbrauhaus
description: Bavarian Heimatabend with the Gebirgstrachten- und Heimatverein D'Schwanstoaner Schwangau: traditional dancing, Schuhplattln and Bavarian brass band music. Table reservations recommended via the Schlossbrauhaus.

title: Rockevent mit Evil Lions
description: "We rock the Ship" party cruise with cover rock band Evil Lions from the Unterallgäu, playing classic rock and heavy metal from the 80s and 90s through to current hits. Boarding from 18:30, departure 19:00, about 2.5 hours. 42 EUR including a welcome drink; tickets online via the Forggensee-Schifffahrt shop or at the evening box office on board.

title: Lechlauf 4.0 Weißenbach am Lech
description: Fourth edition of the Lechlauf trail event along the wild Lech river, roughly 20 minutes from Füssen, on Saturday 19 September. Start times are now fixed: KinderLauf 10:30, HauptLauf 11 km 11:15, HobbyLauf 6.8 km 11:30; the long trails start earlier (05:00, 10:00 and 10:15). Kids skill run plus bouncy castle, climbing and parkour at the Sportplatz. Registration at lechlauf.at, HobbyLauf 25 to 35 EUR.

title: Alphornspielen am Forggensee
description: Last listed date of the season for the alphorn players at the boat landing in Schwangau-Waltenhofen on the Forggensee, alpine horn music by the lake. Free open-air event. Info via Tourist Information Schwangau, schwangau.de.

title: ClassiX Kempten: Universum - Fabian Ziegler & Daniel Schnyder
description: Opening concert of the ClassiX Kempten chamber music festival 2026 under the motto Sonne, Mond und Sterne. Vivaldi and Händel in fresh arrangements with Fabian Ziegler (Marimba) and Daniel Schnyder (Saxophon). Tickets via classix-kempten.de and Theater Kempten.

title: Open Air Konzert: Fabriklar
description: Open air concert by Fabriklar, an eight piece band playing their own funk and soul arrangements, at the Altes Spital in the Füssen old town, presented by the Kulturinitiative Füssen. Start time not published, time tbc, verify at kifuessen.de.

title: RUDOLF - Das Musical (Premiere im Festspielhaus)
description: The musical RUDOLF about the Habsburg crown prince opens at the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein on 19 September 2026 (shows at 14:30 and 19:30 that day) and runs on weekends and selected weekdays through 11 October 2026. Tickets via das-festspielhaus.de or hotline 08362 5077 777.

title: Live-Musik-Abend in der Ludwig Bar
location: Ludwig Bar, AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort, Hohenschwangau
description: Weekly Saturday live music evening in the Ludwig Bar of the AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort in Hohenschwangau, with changing artists each week. Info via the hotel or the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: Frühschoppenkonzert im Biergarten am Festspielhaus
description: Morning Frühschoppen concert in the Festspielhaus beer garden on the Forggensee shore, live music of unverified genre, typically Bavarian brass. The official programme currently lists further Frühschoppenkonzerte at 11:00 on 27 September and 3 October 2026; later October dates that appeared earlier are no longer listed. Free entry, info at das-festspielhaus.de.

title: Frühschoppen mit den Illerblosn
description: Sunday morning Frühschoppen at the Schlossbrauhaus in Schwangau with the Illerblosn, traditional Bavarian Blasmusik (brass band). Free entry to the beer hall, table reservations recommended via the Schlossbrauhaus.

title: Öffentliche Schlossführung Schloss Kronburg
description: Public guided tour of the castle courtyard and museum at Schloss Kronburg, about 1.5 hours, 10 Euro per person. A separate Burgentage Allgäu-Außerfern tour also happens at the castle in September, date to be announced. Registration desired at 08394-271, details at schloss-kronburg.de.

title: ClassiX Kempten: Sonnenaufgang - Chelsea Zurflüh
description: Soprano Chelsea Zurflüh, billed as Supernova mit Jahrhundertstimme, sings at the ClassiX Kempten festival 2026. Tickets via classix-kempten.de and Theater Kempten.

title: EV Füssen vs SC Riessersee (Season Home Opener, Derby)
description: EV Füssen opens the 2026/27 Oberliga Süd home campaign with the classic Bavarian derby against SC Riessersee. The club confirmed the fixture for Sunday 20 September at 18:00 in the heimische Bundesstützpunkt Arena. Expect a full house for the opener, tickets via the EV Füssen online ticket shop at evfuessen.de.

title: Zirkus Charles Knie: SPLASH 2026 (Familienvorstellung)
location: Platz an der Allgäuhalle, Kotterner Str. 54, Kempten
description: Big touring circus in Kempten from 23 to 28 September 2026 with the water show SPLASH, featuring 40 international artists and a 100000 liter water stage. The opening family matinee has tickets from 18 Euro. Further shows daily at 15:30 and 19:30, Sunday at 11:00 and 15:00, Monday only 15:30. Tickets via Reservix or at the box office.

title: ClassiX Kempten: Zenit - Simon Höfele
description: Star trumpeter Simon Höfele performs at the ClassiX Kempten festival 2026, a programme of trumpet brilliance under the festival motto Sonne, Mond und Sterne. Tickets via classix-kempten.de and Theater Kempten.

title: Wirtshausmusik mit der Spätlese Tanzlmusi
description: Wirtshausmusik evening at the Schlossbrauhaus in Schwangau with the Spätlese Tanzlmusi playing traditional Bavarian Tanzlmusi, acoustic folk dance music. Free entry, table reservations recommended via the Schlossbrauhaus.

title: ClassiX Kempten: 1001 Nacht - Mozart meets Scheherazade
description: Evening concert at the ClassiX Kempten festival 2026 combining Mozart with Rimsky-Korsakov's Scheherazade. Tickets via classix-kempten.de and Theater Kempten.

title: Musikalische Grüße
description: Evening of traditional Bavarian Blasmusik (brass band) at the Bannwaldsee Stadl in Schwangau. Info via the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: ClassiX Kempten: Moonlight - David Orlowsky
description: Clarinetist David Orlowsky presents Moonlight, meditation meets classical music, at the ClassiX Kempten festival 2026. Tickets via classix-kempten.de and Theater Kempten.

title: Open Mic #6 der Kulturinitiative Füssen
description: Open microphone evening of the Kulturinitiative Füssen where local musicians and performers present their own material in the Altes Spital in the old town. Start time not yet published, time tbc, verify at kifuessen.de. Usually free or low cost entry.

title: Wiesn an Bord
description: Oktoberfest evening on the Forggensee with hearty Brotzeit, beer and live entertainment by the Original Wasenmooser; Dirndl and Lederhosn encouraged. Boarding from 18:30, departure 19:00, about 2.5 hours. Adults 35 EUR, children 17.50 EUR, including a welcome drink; tickets online via the Forggensee-Schifffahrt shop or on board.

title: Blasmusikfest
description: Bavarian evening with traditional Blasmusik (brass band) at the Bannwaldsee-Stadl by the Bannwaldsee in Schwangau. Info via the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: Festival der Nationen: Eröffnungskonzert mit Sol Gabetta
description: Opening concert of the Festival der Nationen 2026 with star cellist Sol Gabetta and the Deutsche Kammerphilharmonie Bremen under Aurel Dawidiuk, playing Schubert, Elgar and Brahms. A major cello highlight about an hour from Füssen. Tickets via festivaldernationen.de or the Kurhaus box office, phone 08247 9690-444.

title: Musikalische Grüße
description: Evening of traditional Bavarian Blasmusik (brass band) at the Schlossbrauhaus in Schwangau, played by the Musikkapelle Bernbeuren. Free entry to the beer hall, table reservations recommended via the Schlossbrauhaus.

title: Frühschoppen an Bord (Oktoberfest-Wochenende)
description: Cancelled: the Fruehschoppen an Bord does not appear on the 2026 Forggensee-Schifffahrt events program; it was a 2025 event that did not return. Bavarian Frühschoppen with live music aboard the MS Füssen on the 10:00 Große Rundfahrt during the Oktoberfest-Wochenende, at no surcharge over the normal round trip fare of 22 EUR. Boarding from 9:40, departure 10:00, about 2 hours. Tickets on board or via the Forggensee-Schifffahrt online shop.

title: ODEON Jugendsymphonieorchester München: Jubiläumskonzert
description: Jubilee concert of the ODEON Jugendsymphonieorchester München under Julio Doggenweiler Fernández, presented by Kulturring Kaufbeuren. On the programme: Ravel's Ma mère l'oye, Saint-Saëns' Danse Macabre and Stravinsky's Petruschka. Tickets via kaufbeuren.reservix.de.

title: Wiesn an Bord
description: Second night of the Oktoberfest cruise with Brotzeit, beer and live entertainment by the Original Wasenmooser during the Oktoberfest-Wochenende of the Forggensee-Schifffahrt. Boarding from 18:30, departure 19:00, about 2.5 hours. Adults 35 EUR, children 17.50 EUR, including a welcome drink; tickets online via the Forggensee-Schifffahrt shop or on board.

title: Festival der Nationen: Igor Levit & Next Generation
description: Igor Levit plays Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3 with the vbw Festivalorchester under Christoph Adt, framed by the Coriolan overture and Symphony No. 5. Part of the Festival der Nationen 2026 in Bad Wörishofen. Tickets via festivaldernationen.de or the Kurhaus box office, phone 08247 9690-444.

title: Live-Musik-Abend in der Ludwig Bar
location: Ludwig Bar, AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort, Hohenschwangau
description: Last listed Saturday live music evening of the season in the Ludwig Bar of the AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort in Hohenschwangau, with changing artists each week. Info via the hotel or the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: Frühschoppen an Bord (Oktoberfest-Wochenende)
description: Cancelled: the Fruehschoppen an Bord does not appear on the 2026 Forggensee-Schifffahrt events program; it was a 2025 event that did not return. Sunday edition of the Frühschoppen with live music aboard the MS Füssen on the 10:00 Große Rundfahrt, closing the Oktoberfest-Wochenende at no surcharge over the normal fare of 22 EUR. Boarding from 9:40, departure 10:00, about 2 hours. Tickets on board or via the Forggensee-Schifffahrt online shop.

title: Heiterwanger-See-Lauf
description: Traditional autumn run around the scenic Heiterwanger See near Reutte, about 20 minutes from Füssen, on Sunday 27 September. Kids races start the day from 11:00, followed by the 10.4 km main run and 7 km hobby run from the Hotel Fischer am See. Online registration is open at heiterwangerseelauf.at.

title: ClassiX Kempten: Sonnenuntergang - Mélodie Zhao, Klavier
description: Closing concert of ClassiX Kempten 2026: pianist Mélodie Zhao plays an evening glow programme with Chopin and Gershwin. A good pick for piano fans. Tickets via classix-kempten.de and Theater Kempten.

title: Festival der Nationen: Pianissimo! mit Mao Fujita
description: Pianist Mao Fujita performs Prokofiev's Piano Concerto No. 2 with the Bamberger Symphoniker under Jonathan Nott, plus Schubert's Symphony No. 8. Part of the Festival der Nationen 2026. Tickets via festivaldernationen.de or the Kurhaus box office, phone 08247 9690-444.

title: Festival der Nationen: Quadro Nuevo - 30 Jahre um die Welt
description: The world music and jazz ensemble Quadro Nuevo celebrates 30 years of touring the world with a special concert at Hotel Der Sonnenhof, part of the Festival der Nationen 2026. Tickets via festivaldernationen.de or the Kurhaus box office, phone 08247 9690-444.

title: Yakari - Freunde fürs Leben (Kindermusical)
description: Children's musical about the little Sioux boy Yakari and his friends, well suited for 7 year olds. Performed at the MODEON in Marktoberdorf, about 30 minutes from Füssen. Tickets via modeon.de and the usual ticket outlets.

title: Wenn Bühne auf Leben trifft: Jan Ammann und Ensemble
description: Dinner show evening with musical melodies performed by Jan Ammann, Michaela Schober, Verena Mackenberg, Andreas Bieber, Froukje Zuidema and Jan Grossfeld. Begins at 18:00, further shows on 1 October and 4 October 2026. Tickets via das-festspielhaus.de. Further performances on 1 and 4 October 2026, both at 18:00.

title: Festival der Nationen: Julia Fischer spielt Vivaldis Vier Jahreszeiten
description: Violinist Julia Fischer, who began her career at this festival as a 13 year old, plays Vivaldi's Four Seasons and Mendelssohn with the Kammerorchester des Bayerischen Rundfunks led by Radoslaw Szulc. Part of the Festival der Nationen 2026. Tickets via festivaldernationen.de or the Kurhaus box office, phone 08247 9690-444.

title: Wirtshausbühne: Das Glück kommt durch die Hintertür
description: Uli Pickl's Wirtshausbühne brings the Bavarian comedy Das Glück kommt durch die Hintertür to the Schlossbrauhaus in Schwangau. Dialect theatre in the beer hall, reservations recommended.

title: Blasmusikfest
description: Bavarian evening with traditional Blasmusik (brass band) at the Bannwaldsee-Stadl by the Bannwaldsee in Schwangau. Info via the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: Festival der Nationen: Rudolf Buchbinder spielt Mozart
description: Piano legend Rudolf Buchbinder plays Mozart with the Festival Strings Lucerne, joined by cellist Charlotte Melkonian in a Haydn concerto. Part of the Festival der Nationen 2026 in Bad Wörishofen. Tickets via festivaldernationen.de or the Kurhaus box office, phone 08247 9690-444.

title: Gaupreisplattln Aktiv
description: Public Gau competition in Schuhplattln, the traditional Bavarian slap dance, with dancers from the local Trachten clubs. Listed as öffentlich in the Weissensee Terminkalender 2026.

title: Maus-Türöffnertag: Technik entdecken und ausprobieren
description: Hands-on technology day for kids at Hochschule Kempten as part of the nationwide Sendung mit der Maus Türöffnertag. Currently SOLD OUT; watch the university events page for returned places. Free.

title: Kunsthandwerkermarkt am Schlossbrauhaus
description: Autumn edition of the open air craft market by Schröder Märkte at the Schlossbrauhaus with selected artisans and designers. Saturday 11:00 to 17:00 and Sunday 10:00 to 17:00, admission free. Info at schroeder-maerkte.de.

title: Wilde Fahrt mit den AlpenGrageelern
description: Autumn dinner cruise with live music by the AlpenGrageeler and a three course Wildmenü (game menu), drinks not included. Boarding from 19:00, departure 19:30, about 2.5 hours. Adults 75 EUR, children 60 EUR; advance booking via the Forggensee-Schifffahrt online shop is required since menu events cannot be bought at the on-board box office.

title: Festival der Nationen: Sonderkonzert zum 70. Geburtstag von Nigel Kennedy
description: Violinist Nigel Kennedy celebrates his 70th birthday with Bach performed together with The Kennedy Bach Ensemble. Special concert of the Festival der Nationen 2026. Tickets via festivaldernationen.de or the Kurhaus box office, phone 08247 9690-444.

title: Erntedank Kirchzug mit Kirchenkaffee
description: Harvest thanksgiving procession to the parish church St. Walburga with festive service and Kirchenkaffee afterwards. Public village event listed in the official Weissensee Vereinstermine 2026.

title: Festival der Nationen: Abschlussgala 270 Jahre Mozart mit Rolando Villazón
description: Closing gala of the Festival der Nationen 2026 marking 270 years of Mozart, with star tenor Rolando Villazón and PRJCT Amsterdam under Maarten Engeltjes. Tickets via festivaldernationen.de or the Kurhaus box office, phone 08247 9690-444.

title: Filmvorführung "Der Forggensee"
description: Screening of the documentary film Der Forggensee at the Schlossbrauhaus in Schwangau, about the lake on the doorstep and the surrounding Königswinkel. Repeated on 18 October and 8 November, each at 20:15. Free entry, table reservations recommended.

title: Im Weißen Rössl (Dinner-Show)
description: Dinner show of the operetta Im Weißen Rössl (Singspiel with vocal soloists) at the Festspielhaus, including a three course menu and welcome drink. This entry marks the first evening; further shows on 8, 15, 16, 17 and 18 October 2026, all at 18:00. Tickets via das-festspielhaus.de or hotline 08362 5077 777.

title: DAV Sektionsabend: Unterwegs im Polarkreis (Armin Hofmann)
location: Aula der Grundschule am Aybühlweg, Kempten
description: Travel and adventure lecture evening of the DAV Sektion Allgäu-Kempten with Armin Hofmann about journeys through Norway and Lapland in the Arctic Circle (Unterwegs im Polarkreis). Starts 19:00 in the Aula of the Grundschule am Aybühlweg in Kempten, free entry, non-members welcome. Details at dav-kempten.de.

title: 2. Fire Trail Nesselwang
description: The second Fire Trail Nesselwang turns the Alpspitz area into a trail running arena on Saturday 10 October, about 20 minutes from Füssen. Bib collection 07:30 to 09:30 at the Explorer Hotel start area, first runner off at 10:00 with the rest starting at 30 second intervals by bib number, award ceremony around 13:00 and a grill evening at the fire station from 18:00. Info and registration at fire-trail-nesselwang.de.

title: Krimi-Dinner "Testament à la Carte"
description: Murder mystery dinner cruise closing the event season, an interactive Kriminal-Dinner performance with a three course menu, drinks not included; admission from age 16. Boarding from 18:30, departure 19:00, about 4 hours. 109 EUR per person; advance booking via the Forggensee-Schifffahrt online shop is required since menu events cannot be bought at the on-board box office.

title: Blasmusikfest
description: Bavarian evening with traditional Blasmusik (brass band) at the Bannwaldsee-Stadl by the Bannwaldsee in Schwangau. Info via the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: Colomansfest mit Colomansritt
description: Schwangau's biggest traditional festival honouring St. Coloman, with around 200 decorated horses. The procession leaves the Rathaus at 9:30 behind the Musikkapelle Schwangau and moves to the field mass at the pilgrimage church St. Coloman, followed by the horse blessing with the Coloman relic and the ceremonial ride around the church. A second devotion with individual blessings follows at 15:00. Food and drink stalls, free to attend.

title: Festkonzert 200 Jahre Chor der Basilika: Bruckner Messe f-moll & Te Deum
description: Anniversary concert for 200 years of the Basilika choir: Bruckner's Mass No. 3 in F minor and the Te Deum with vocal soloists, the Chor der Basilika, Vokalensemble Kempten and the Kammerphilharmonie Bodensee-Oberschwaben, choir and orchestra in the baroque basilica. Tickets 26/22/13 EUR. Program at basilikamusik-kempten.de.

title: Reinhold Messner: Über Leben - Der neue Live-Vortrag
description: The legendary mountaineer Reinhold Messner presents his new multimedia live lecture Über Leben, telling his path from South Tyrolean farm boy to the most famous adventurer of our time. Right in Füssen at the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein. Tickets from 44.90 Euro via das-festspielhaus.de or the Theaterkasse, phone 08362 5077 777. Likely to sell well, book early.

title: Weinfest am Festspielhaus
description: Three day wine festival at the Festspielhaus on the Forggensee shore, 16 to 18 October, daily roughly 10:00 to 17:00 per the house program. Coincides with the Im Weißen Rössl dinner shows in the evenings. Info at das-festspielhaus.de.

title: Der Troubadour (Opera Romana)
description: Giuseppe Verdi's opera Il Trovatore, staged in German as Der Troubadour by Opera Romana at the MODEON in Marktoberdorf: solo voices, chorus and orchestra in a full evening of dramatic Italian opera. Tickets via modeon.de.

title: Samuel Heinrich: Handpan und Synthesizer
description: Samuel Heinrich plays an electro-acoustic set that combines handpan with synthesizers, presented by the Kulturinitiative Füssen at the Altes Spital in the old town. Start time not published, time tbc, verify at kifuessen.de.

title: Schanzenlauf Oberstdorf
description: Race up the roughly 1000 steps of the Oberstdorf ski flying hill with 162 m of climbing, organised by the Feuerwehr Oberstdorf, a fun spectacle to watch with kids. Start listed around 08:00 but not officially confirmed, time tbc, verify before travelling.

title: 35. Rottachseelauf Oy-Mittelberg
description: The 35. Rottachseelauf of TSV Petersthal on Saturday 17 October: 15 km main run from age 16, 2.4 km for U14 and U16 and 1.2 km for U8, U10 and U12, about 30 minutes from Füssen. Neither the LADV Ausschreibung nor the club page publishes start times; secondary running calendars give 13:30 for the children's races and 14:00 for the 15 km, so time tbc, verify with TSV Petersthal before travelling. Registration via tsvpetersthal.de.

title: Zirkus Charles Knie: SPLASH 2026 (Kaufbeuren)
description: Zirkus Charles Knie brings its water-themed show SPLASH to Kaufbeuren from 15 to 19 October, closer to home than the Kempten dates. Forty international artists and comedians from ten nations mixing acrobatics, dance, music and comedy. Performances daily at 15:30 and 19:30, Sunday 11:00 and 15:00, Monday 15:30 only. Family prices from 18 EUR.

title: Wirtshausmusik mit der Kerzenstoana Spiel Partie
description: Wirtshausmusik evening at the Schlossbrauhaus in Schwangau with the Kerzenstoana Spiel Partie playing traditional Bavarian folk music on acoustic instruments. Free entry, table reservations recommended via the Schlossbrauhaus.

title: Blasmusikabend
description: Evening of traditional Bavarian Blasmusik (brass band) at the Bannwaldsee-Stadl in Schwangau. Info via the Schwangau event calendar at schwangau.de.

title: Törgellenabend
description: South Tyrolean style Törggelen evening of the Schützenhausgesellschaft with new wine, chestnuts and hearty food at the Schützenhaus. Public event listed in the official Weissensee Vereinstermine 2026.

title: Günther Jauch trifft Best of Festspielhaus
description: Afternoon show combining Günther Jauch with a Best of Festspielhaus programme of musical highlights. Tickets from about 50 euros via das-festspielhaus.de or the ticket hotline 08362 5077 777.

title: Reinhold Messner: Über Leben - Der neue Live-Vortrag
description: Second regional date of Reinhold Messner's multimedia lecture Über Leben, a look back over seven decades as mountaineer, adventurer and family man. Sunday evening at the Oberstdorf Haus, about an hour from Füssen. Tickets from 44.90 Euro via eventim.de. Alternative if the Füssen date is sold out.

title: Filmvorführung "Der Forggensee"
description: Second October screening of the documentary film Der Forggensee at the Schlossbrauhaus in Schwangau. Free entry, table reservations recommended.

title: Zeppelin - Das Musical
description: Ralph Siegel's musical about the age of the airships returns to the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein. This entry marks the start of the run on 22 October 2026; performances continue Wednesdays to Sundays through 15 November 2026. Tickets via das-festspielhaus.de or hotline 08362 5077 777.

title: Wirtshausbühne: Das Glück kommt durch die Hintertür
description: Further date of Uli Pickl's Wirtshausbühne playing the Bavarian comedy Das Glück kommt durch die Hintertür at the Schlossbrauhaus in Schwangau. Reservations recommended.

title: EV Füssen vs ESV Kaufbeuren (Allgäu Derby)
description: Allgäu derby in the Oberliga Süd as EV Füssen hosts neighbours ESV Kaufbeuren on a Friday night. Kaufbeuren travel with a big away following, so this is one of the hottest home dates of the Hauptrunde. Listed face-off 19:30, verify on evfuessen.de closer to the date; tickets via the EV Füssen online shop.

title: Herbstmarkt Weissensee
description: Autumn market of the Schützengesellschaft Weissensee in the hall of the Schützenhaus, with local crafts and refreshments. Opens at 10:00, free entry. Listed in the official Weissensee Vereinstermine 2026.

title: Heimatabend am Schlossbrauhaus
description: Bavarian Heimatabend with the Gebirgstrachten- und Heimatverein D'Schwanstoaner Schwangau: Schuhplattln, traditional dances and brass band music. Table reservations recommended via the Schlossbrauhaus.

title: EV Füssen vs Tölzer Löwen (Bavarian Derby)
description: Oberliga Süd home game against the Tölzer Löwen, one of the traditional Bavarian rivalries and usually a well attended Friday night in Füssen. Face-off 19:30.

title: Der Klassiker: FC Bayern München vs Borussia Dortmund
description: The Hinrunde edition of Der Klassiker is now terminiert: Bundesliga matchday 8 at the Allianz Arena on Saturday 31 October 2026, kickoff 18:30 in the Samstagabend slot. Tickets via fcbayern.com, live on Sky.

title: BEL CANTO ME: Opernstudio des Gärtnerplatztheaters
description: The production previously announced as Sommernachtsträume now runs under the title BEL CANTO ME, a staged Liederabend by the Opernstudio des Staatstheaters am Gärtnerplatz inspired by A Midsummer Night's Dream. Singers Yoojin Lee, Tamara Obermayr, Thomas McGowan and Juho Stén with Hibiki Sagae at the piano, in works by Monteverdi, Purcell, Mozart, Schubert, Gounod, Donizetti, Sondheim and Elton John. Tickets via theaterinkempten.de.

title: Wirtshausbühne: Das Glück kommt durch die Hintertür
description: Last listed date of Uli Pickl's Wirtshausbühne with the Bavarian comedy Das Glück kommt durch die Hintertür at the Schlossbrauhaus in Schwangau. Reservations recommended.

title: Heimatabend am Schlossbrauhaus
description: November Heimatabend with the Gebirgstrachten- und Heimatverein D'Schwanstoaner Schwangau: Schuhplattln, traditional dances and brass band music. Table reservations recommended via the Schlossbrauhaus.

title: Die Schöne und das Biest - das Musical
description: Family musical version of Beauty and the Beast at the MODEON in Marktoberdorf, a Saturday afternoon show that works well for 7 year olds. Tickets via modeon.de and the usual ticket outlets.

title: GUACAYO live im Café Bar Ifni
description: Club show of the Hamburg indie pop band GUACAYO in the small Café Bar Ifni in the Füssen old town. Listed start 18:00 with tickets from about 24 Euro via perto.com and ticket outlets. Small room, buying in advance is sensible.

title: Ronsberger Sparkassen-Crosslauf
description: Autumn cross country race of about 8 km on trails in the Obergünzburg and Ronsberg area, roughly 45 minutes from Füssen. Cross-country events of this kind usually include children's races. The running calendar listed Obergünzburg as the reference town, so the exact start location is unconfirmed, and no start time is published yet. Location and time tbc, verify.

title: Die Bremer Stadtmusikanten (Marionettentheater Bille)
description: Guest performance of the Marionettentheater Bille with the Grimm tale Die Bremer Stadtmusikanten as a marionette show, 60 minutes, for children from age 3. Children 7.50 EUR, adults 9.50 EUR. Info at puppentheater-kaufbeuren.de.

title: Großes Kreissingen
description: Five regional choirs from the district sing together at the MODEON in Marktoberdorf, choral music ranging across popular and traditional repertoire. Tickets via modeon.de.

title: Ein Konzert für Frieden: Markus Stockhausen, Dinesh Mishra & Friends
location: Festsaal des Klosters Irsee, Irsee bei Kaufbeuren
description: Seven musicians around trumpeter Markus Stockhausen and bansuri player Dinesh Mishra blend free improvisation, classical Indian music and European jazz in a transcultural concert for peace, held on the eve of 9 November in the Festsaal of Kloster Irsee. Presented by Kulturring Kaufbeuren. Tickets via kaufbeuren.reservix.de.

title: Filmvorführung "Der Forggensee"
description: November screening of the documentary film Der Forggensee at the Schlossbrauhaus in Schwangau. Free entry, table reservations recommended.

title: DAV Sektionsabend: Auf Solo-Wanderung (Nina Rühlig, GR10 Pyrenäen)
location: Aula der Grundschule am Aybühlweg, Kempten
description: Multivision adventure talk of the DAV Sektion Allgäu-Kempten: Nina Rühlig reports on her 930 km solo hike along the GR10 across the Pyrenees. Free entry, non-members welcome. Details at dav-kempten.de.

title: 25. Romantischer Weihnachtsmarkt Schloss Kronburg (1. Wochenende)
description: The 25th Romantischer Weihnachtsmarkt in the courtyard of Schloss Kronburg with artisan craftspeople in a castle setting, one of the most atmospheric Christmas markets in the Allgäu. First weekend runs 13 to 15 November 2026. Opening hours not yet published, time tbc, verify at schloss-kronburg.de before going.

title: Lumagica Reutte - Eröffnung des Lichterparks auf Ehrenberg
description: Opening day of the magical light park Lumagica at the castle world Ehrenberg near Reutte, with illuminated animals and mythical creatures along a walk through the historic fortress grounds. Season runs 13 November 2026 to 21 February 2027, open Friday to Sunday 17:00 to 21:00 until 20 December, then daily over Christmas. The Lumagica ticket includes entry to the Reutte on Ice ice park. Tickets and info at reutte.com and ehrenberg.at.

title: EV Füssen vs EC Peiting (Oberland Derby)
description: Removed from the calendar: this fixture is an AWAY game at EC Peiting, not a Fuessen home game (eishockeynews.de season table lists Peiting as home team). Fuessen home games against Peiting are on 8 January and 12 February 2027. Oberliga Süd home game against near neighbours EC Peiting, a short-distance Oberland derby with a lively away following. Face-off 19:30.

title: Veteranenjahrtag
description: Annual memorial day of the Veteranenverein Weissensee on Volkstrauertag weekend, with church service and commemoration followed by a gathering at the Schützenhaus. Public event listed in the official Weissensee Vereinstermine 2026.

title: NFL Munich Game 2026: New England Patriots vs Detroit Lions
description: The NFL returns to Munich for a week 10 regular season game between the New England Patriots and the Detroit Lions with German star Amon-Ra St. Brown. Kickoff is Sunday 15 November at 15:30 at the Allianz Arena. Tickets sell out fast and run roughly 84 to 414 Euro via Ticketmaster.

title: 25. Romantischer Weihnachtsmarkt Schloss Kronburg (2. Wochenende)
description: Second weekend of the 25th Romantischer Weihnachtsmarkt at Schloss Kronburg, 20 to 22 November 2026, with artisan stalls in the historic castle courtyard. Opening hours not yet published, time tbc, verify at schloss-kronburg.de before going.

title: Alice im Wunderland (Theater, Tanz, Akrobatik, Zirkuskunst)
description: Family show of Alice in Wonderland combining theater, dance, acrobatics and circus arts at the MODEON in Marktoberdorf. A visually rich evening show suitable for children. Tickets via modeon.de and the usual ticket outlets.

title: Öffentliche Generalprobe der Musikkapelle Weissensee
description: Public dress rehearsal of the Musikkapelle Weissensee brass band ahead of its Jahreskonzert, a relaxed way to hear the full concert programme. Listed as öffentlich in the Weissensee Terminkalender 2026 but with no start time published, time tbc, verify.

title: Erlebnis-Weihnachtsmarkt Bad Hindelang (1. Wochenende)
description: Opening weekend of the famous medieval-style Erlebnisweihnacht that turns the whole village centre of Bad Hindelang into a historic Christmas town, Thursday to Sunday. The Märchenumzug parade with about 150 fairy tale figures runs on Friday and Sunday (about 1 hour). Children under 12 free; entry includes shuttle buses and parking. Opening hours tbc, verify at badhindelang.de.

title: Der Geist der Weihnacht - Das Musical
description: Premiere of Der Geist der Weihnacht, the Festspielhaus musical of Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol, with live band. Billed as a musical for the whole family, age recommendation 5 and up, about 2.5 hours plus a 30 minute interval. The run continues to 12 December with further afternoon and evening dates. Tickets from 49.99 EUR.

title: Meisterkonzert: Litauisches Staatliches Sinfonieorchester
description: Symphony orchestra concert with the Lithuanian State Symphony Orchestra under Gintaras Rinkevicius and horn soloist Bastian Spier: Weber's Oberon overture, Richard Strauss's Horn Concerto No. 1 and Brahms's Symphony No. 3. Tickets 22 to 58 EUR via theaterinkempten.de.

title: Der Geist der Weihnacht - Das Musical (Matinee)
description: Saturday afternoon performance of Der Geist der Weihnacht, the Festspielhaus musical of Dickens' A Christmas Carol with live band. A musical for the whole family, age recommendation 5 and up, about 2.5 hours plus a 30 minute interval. Tickets from 49.99 EUR.

title: Dornröschen (Royal Classical Ballet)
description: The Royal Classical Ballet dances Dornröschen (Sleeping Beauty) at the MODEON in Marktoberdorf, a full length classical ballet with elaborate sets and around 300 costumes. A good first ballet for the boys if they can sit through a full evening. Tickets via modeon.de.

title: Jahreskonzert der Musikkapelle Weissensee
description: Annual concert of the Musikkapelle Weissensee at the Schützenhaus in Roßmoos, the musical highlight of the village year. A public dress rehearsal is also scheduled on 22 November, time not published. Listed in the official Weissensee Vereinstermine 2026, info via the Musikkapelle at +49 162 7137153.

title: Weihnachtsmarkt am Kiosk
description: Small village Christmas market run jointly by all Weissensee Vereine at the Kiosk am Freibad on the lake, on the first Advent Sunday from 12:00. Mulled wine, food stalls and music by the lake. Listed in the official Weissensee Vereinstermine 2026.

title: Quadro Nuevo: Weihnachtslieder
description: The acoustic instrumental quartet Quadro Nuevo (saxophone, clarinet, double bass, accordion, bandoneon, trumpet and guitar) plays its atmospheric Christmas songs program. Tickets 28 EUR via theaterinkempten.de; listed in the Spielzeit 2026/27 program.

title: Erlebnis-Weihnachtsmarkt Bad Hindelang (2. Wochenende)
description: Second weekend of the medieval-style Erlebnisweihnacht in Bad Hindelang, Thursday to Sunday, with the Märchenumzug parade of about 150 fairy tale figures on Friday and Sunday. Children under 12 free; entry includes shuttle buses and parking. Opening hours tbc, verify at badhindelang.de.

title: DAV Sektionsabend: Faszination Höhlen
location: Aula der Grundschule am Aybühlweg, Kempten
description: Lecture evening of the DAV Sektion Allgäu-Kempten with films and photos from the caves of the Vercors and Chartreuse massifs in France. Free entry, non-members welcome. Details at dav-kempten.de.

title: Füssener Adventsmarkt (2. Adventswochenende)
description: Romantic Advent market in the baroque monastery courtyard of St. Mang, on the second Advent weekend, themed Zauberhaft, märchenhaft this year. Opening times Friday 17:00 to 20:00, Saturday and Sunday 11:00 to 20:00. Free admission. Stilt walkers, an ice princess and other walkabout performers for the children, plus regional musicians and singers on the baroque loggia including alphorn players and a children's choir.

title: Der Geist der Weihnacht - Das Musical (Matinee)
description: Advent Saturday matinee of Der Geist der Weihnacht at the Festspielhaus, Dickens' A Christmas Carol as a musical with live band. Family show, age recommendation 5 and up, about 2.5 hours plus interval. Tickets from 59.99 EUR for this date.

title: Hakuna Matata - Die große Kindermusical-Gala
description: Children's musical gala of vocal highlights from the best known musicals and Disney films, including König der Löwen, Die Eiskönigin and Tabaluga, with songs to sing and dance along to. A show for the whole family. Tickets from about 26 to 32 EUR.

title: Nikolauslauf Immenstadt
description: Cancelled for 2026: runme.de states the Nikolauslauf Immenstadt findet im aktuellen Jahr nicht statt and hdsports knows of no further edition. Nikolaus themed December road race at Immenstadt with 5 km and 10 km options, about an hour from Füssen. Start time not yet published, time tbc, verify.

title: Der Räuber Hotzenplotz
description: Otfried Preußler's Der Räuber Hotzenplotz as a stage play at the Stadttheater Kempten, the classic children's story of the robber, Kasperl and Seppel. Further public performances on 13, 19 and 20 December, all at 16:00. Tickets via theaterinkempten.de, these Sunday shows sell out early.

title: Erlebnis-Weihnachtsmarkt Bad Hindelang (3. Wochenende)
description: Final weekend of the medieval-style Erlebnisweihnacht in Bad Hindelang, Thursday to Sunday, with the Märchenumzug parade of about 150 fairy tale figures on Friday and Sunday. Children under 12 free; entry includes shuttle buses and parking. Opening hours tbc, verify at badhindelang.de.

title: Füssener Adventsmarkt (3. Adventswochenende)
description: Second and final weekend of the Füssener Adventsmarkt in the Klosterhof St. Mang, falling on the third Advent weekend. Opening times Friday 14:00 to 20:00, Saturday 11:00 to 20:00, Sunday 11:00 to 19:00. Free admission, walkabout performers and regional music on the baroque loggia.

title: Nikolausschießen
description: Nikolaus shooting competition of the Weissensee Schützen, a public winter evening in the Schützenstüble. Listed as öffentlich in the Weissensee Terminkalender 2026.

title: Adventsnachmittag
description: Advent afternoon hosted by the parish in the Magnushaus, with coffee, cake and Advent music. Public event, also listed in the Füssen Tourismus calendar.

title: Wouldn't You Like to Be on Broadway: der amerikanische Kurt Weill
description: Soprano Nicole Baumann and pianist Philip Tillotson perform the American Broadway songs of Kurt Weill, a vocal and piano recital in the intimate TheaterOben. Further performances 13 December 18:00 and 17 December 20:00. Tickets 24 EUR via theaterinkempten.de.

title: WE LOVE CHRISTMAS
description: Christmas concert with four musical stars singing festive songs and musical highlights at the Festspielhaus, a family friendly Advent Sunday afternoon show. Tickets from 39.99 EUR via das-festspielhaus.de or hotline 08362 5077 777.

title: Konzert bei Kerzenschein: Vokalensemble Kempten
description: Advent candlelight concert with the Vokalensemble Kempten, a vocal ensemble singing works by Aichinger and Rutter, accompanied by Maximilian Pöllner on the organ (not an organ recital). Tickets 20/15/10 EUR. Program at basilikamusik-kempten.de.

title: Klassik Radio live in Concert: Die Nacht der Filmmusik
description: Orchestral film music programme conducted by Pete Harrison and presented by Thomas Ohrner at the bigBOX ALLGÄU in Kempten, full orchestra playing well known film scores. Doors 19:00, start 20:00. Tickets via tickets.klassikradio.de.

title: Brandner Kaspar - Das Musical
description: The Bavarian tale of the Brandner Kaspar and the Boandlkramer staged as a musical with ensemble and live band at the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein. A matinee runs the same day at 15:00 and a further performance on 20 December at 14:00. Tickets via das-festspielhaus.de.

title: Der Räuber Hotzenplotz
description: Last of the Christmas run of Der Räuber Hotzenplotz at the Stadttheater Kempten, children's theatre after Otfried Preußler. Tickets via theaterinkempten.de.

title: Ein Weihnachtsoratorium: Barockorchester La Banda
description: The baroque orchestra La Banda with singers performs Christmas cantatas by Christoph Graupner as Ein Weihnachtsoratorium, part of the Wieskonzerte series, in St. Anna in Schongau (about 35 minutes from Füssen). Performances at 11:00 and 17:00 on the 4th Advent Sunday. Tickets via wieskonzerte.de.

title: Das zauberhafte Land von Oz (Premiere)
description: Premiere of the family musical Das zauberhafte Land von Oz at the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein: Dorothy is blown to the land of Oz and travels with the scarecrow, the tin man and the cowardly lion, with live music and large scale staging. Recommended from age 5, about 2 hours plus a 30 minute interval. Tickets from 39.99 EUR via das-festspielhaus.de.

title: EV Füssen vs SC Riessersee (Vorweihnachts-Derby)
description: Oberliga Süd derby against SC Riessersee two days before Christmas, traditionally one of the best-attended home games of the season. Face-off 19:30 per the eishockeynews season table.

title: Das zauberhafte Land von Oz
description: Boxing Day matinee of the family musical Das zauberhafte Land von Oz at the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein, from age 5, about 2 hours plus interval. Daily matinees at 14:30 from 26 to 30 December. Tickets from 39.99 EUR via das-festspielhaus.de.

title: EV Füssen vs Tölzer Löwen (Bavarian Derby)
description: Oberliga Süd home game against the Tölzer Löwen between Christmas and New Year, one of the classic Bavarian derbies and usually a full house at the Bundesstützpunkt Arena. Face off 18:00. Tickets at the box office or via evfuessen.de.

title: Glühweinparty der Feuerwehr
description: Public mulled wine party of the Feuerwehr Weissensee at the fire station in the village, listed as öffentlich in the Weissensee Terminkalender 2026. An easy walk-to evening between the years.

title: Pianotainment: Das Jubiläumskonzert
description: Marcel Dorn and Stephan Weh celebrate 30 years of Pianotainment at the Stadttheater Kempten, a four hands piano show on one instrument ranging from baroque to rock and tango to techno, with surprise guests. Tickets 17 to 46 EUR via theaterinkempten.de.

title: Silvesterkonzert: Smetana Philharmoniker Prag
description: New Year's Eve concert with the Smetana Philharmoniker Prag under Hans Richter at the Stadttheater Kempten, a full symphony orchestra playing film music from Harry Potter and My Fair Lady to James Bond. Only one performance this season and it is in the afternoon at 15:00. Tickets via theaterinkempten.de.

title: LUDWIG² an Silvester
description: New Year's Eve performance of Ludwig², the Festspielhaus flagship musical about King Ludwig II, with ensemble and live band in the theatre on the Forggensee. Tickets via das-festspielhaus.de.

title: Das zauberhafte Land von Oz
description: New Year matinee of the family musical Das zauberhafte Land von Oz at the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein, from age 5, about 2 hours plus interval. A further show follows on 3 January at 11:00. Tickets from 39.99 EUR via das-festspielhaus.de.

title: Das zauberhafte Land von Oz
description: Heilige Drei Könige holiday matinee of Das zauberhafte Land von Oz at the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein, from age 5. Further performances on 7 January at 14:30, 9 January at 14:30 and 10 January at 11:00. Tickets from 39.99 EUR via das-festspielhaus.de.

title: Ludwig meets Michael Jackson
description: Crossover concert show at the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein pairing the Ludwig² songbook with Michael Jackson hits, sung by the Festspielhaus ensemble with live band. Tickets via das-festspielhaus.de.

title: EV Füssen vs EC Peiting (Oberland Derby)
description: Oberliga Süd home game against EC Peiting, the short trip Oberland derby that Füssen hosts only once in the main round. Face off 19:30. Tickets at the box office or via evfuessen.de.

title: Brandner Kaspar - Das Musical
description: Brandner Kaspar - Das Musical returns to the Festspielhaus Neuschwanstein for a January run, the Bavarian tale of the man who outwits death, with ensemble and live band. A further performance follows on 15 January at 19:30. Tickets via das-festspielhaus.de.
